notes.title: Update - Changelogs 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hi.

This is the first big update of the game.

Tons of things has been fixed.

[b] Here's the most important changes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Added the possibility to remove ammo and attachments from weapons.
[*]Map updated: New locations and models
[*]New grass.
[*]Visual quality improvements.
[*]Big performance optimization.
[*]Several other fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Game release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

As someone pointed out, there are some fixes and improvements that the game should get, and starting from 24 Hours from now I'll work on them. For a while I will deliver some updates, at least once a week.

Some things that someone suggested are:

-Volume management setting [ADDED]
-Terrain problems on Mac OS. [FIXED]
-Problems recording game with some softwares. [FIXED]

If you have some of those problems, or some other ones, please leave a comment here.
The game is complete, but working alone I could have forgot some minor stuff, and I'm ready to fix them.

Marco
